official_definition: This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/Green Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects. While "Strikewurm" is during Contract Advent on this card, add White/Blue to this effect.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Contract Armor] or [Contract Armor: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Contract Armor]", "give [Contract Armor]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
